skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Fragrant Pace
skins.content: 0011 Yun Series/Fragrant Pace. A jacket and skirt woven by Dahuang's weavers for the festivities, gifted to Grain Buds to wear as she wanders the fields. Around her, the wonders of nature. By her side, fine friends to be sure.
skins.usage: One of Grain Buds's casual outfits.
skins.quote: Fragrant dumplings of jade, lightly wound in brightest thread. Mount and stream bright and green, around orchids do we tread.
